up: Retrieve activity records for compound CHEMBL941 and all its related forms (parent and salts) by joining molecule_hierarchy where parent_molregno or molregno matches CHEMBL941's molregno. Filter activities for standard_type = 'IC50' and standard_units = 'nM'. Restrict to assays with chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1936'. Join activities to compound_records on record_id, to docs on doc_id, to assays on assay_id, and to target_dictionary on assays.tid. Return exactly: compound_chembl_id (molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), canonical_smiles (compound_structures.canonical_smiles), compound_key (compound_records.compound_key), pubmed_id_or_doi (compute as docs.pubmed_id if not null else docs.doi), assay_description (assays.description), standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment (all from activities), target_chembl_id (assays.chembl_id), target_name (target_dictionary.pref_name), target_organism (target_dictionary.organism). Do not apply any row limit.
sql:
WITH related_mols AS (
  SELECT mh.molregno
  FROM molecule_hierarchy mh
  JOIN molecule_dictionary parent ON mh.parent_molregno = parent.molregno
  WHERE parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL941'
)
SELECT
  md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cr.compound_key,
  COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  a.description AS assay_description,
  act.standard_type,
  act.standard_relation,
  act.standard_value,
  act.standard_units,
  act.activity_comment,
  a.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  td.organism AS target_organism
FROM activities act
JOIN related_mols rm ON act.molregno = rm.molregno
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON act.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN compound_records cr ON act.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN docs d ON act.doc_id = d.doc_id
JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON a.tid = td.tid
WHERE
  a.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1936'
  AND act.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND act.standard_units = 'nM'
